data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error: qwen model crashed with HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing cline-desktop.desktop, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review cline-desktop.desktop due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Tool errors (API crashes, timeouts) should be automatically retried or fall back to an alternative model rather than marking the file as inconclusive
The audit system should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool error' and 'inconclusive due to genuine uncertainty' when aggregating verdicts
When one model fails due to a tool error on a specific file, the system should recognize this as a coverage gap rather than a disagreement requiring escalation
